args.body: Hi Dora, Emma asked me to visit your website and share feedback. From the content I could access, it clearly identifies the site as yours and makes your email easy to find. I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect, plus some examples of your work or interests to give the site more personality. I could only access a small amount of text, so I can't assess the visual design or navigation.

Hi Eve, Emma asked me to visit your blog and share feedback. From the content I could access, mentioning hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a promising theme. I'd suggest expanding that introduction with what readers can expect, and adding hiking stories, trail tips, or photos to help visitors connect with your interests. I could only access a small amount of text, so I can't assess the visual design or navigation.

final_text:
I visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her site, and sent feedback to Dora and Eve.

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a personal introduction and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested expanding her hiking theme with stories, trail tips, or photos.

Only limited text was available from each site, so I noted that I couldn’t assess their visual design or navigation.
